name: Big word pops
what: Huge orange words with confetti when you stress one.
when: Explainers with a few words you stress.
instruction: Lay out the big-word-pops format. Pick the four single words or two-word phrases the speaker stresses hardest and add a pop at each, text in caps, 1.2 seconds. If the speaker lists five or more things in a row, add one cloud with those words at the moment the list starts. Add one gradient hook at 0:00 with a two-line reframe of the topic and a short sub line. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.

name: Split screen
when: Walking through a tool, a doc or a dashboard.
instruction: Lay out the split-screen format. Find the three moments where a screenshot, product or document is being described and add a reframe with corner split for 7 seconds at each. Add one title at 0:00, sentence case, not a quote. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.

name: Numbered list
what: A numbered list that builds as you talk.
instruction: Lay out the numbered-build format. Write a title for 0:00 that reframes the topic in under six words. Find every item the speaker enumerates and add one list with a line per item, each pinned to the moment it is said, numbered, look plain. If there is a moment worth a white card, add one card. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.

name: Picture in picture
what: You shrink to a corner while a photo fills the frame.
when: Stories about a company, a person, something you can show.
instruction: Lay out the insert-and-shrink format. Find each named company, person, product or event and add a reframe with corner bl for 6 seconds at the moment it is first named. Add a title at 0:00 that is a claim, not a quote. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.

name: Loud captions
what: Big bold captions, live word in yellow.

name: Handwritten
when: Casual and personal, a bit rough on purpose.
instruction: Lay out the handwritten format. Add one title at 0:00 in face scrawl, lowercase, not a quote. Where a name, product or place is first said, add a gradient with that single word, face scrawl, 2 seconds. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.

name: Comment reply
what: Opens on a comment, then you answer it.
when: Answering something people keep asking you.
instruction: Lay out the comment-reply format. Write the question this talk answers as a comment from a made-up handle and add it as a comment card at 0:00 for 4 seconds. Add one pop on the word where the answer lands. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.

name: Story
when: A memory, a turning point, something told outdoors.
instruction: Lay out the story format. Add a letterbox. Find the one number or phrase the story turns on and add a pop there, 1.5 seconds. Nothing else. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.

name: One big jolt
what: One punch-in and bass hit on your best line.
when: A talk with one line that really lands.
instruction: Lay out the one-jolt format. Find the single most surprising or contrarian line and add a cow there for 0.7 seconds, plus a pop with the two words that carry it. Add a title at 0:00 that is a claim, not a quote. Nothing else. Place at most four things across the whole clip and spread them out; leave the rest of the video plain.
